business.type: supply and installation of LED screens
offer: pool, garden and home-cinema LED screens
objections: will it be visible in direct sun
will it survive water and chlorine

concept.idea: Clear as night, even in the August sun.
concept.claim: A normal TV disappears at noon. An LED screen from Switching stays sharp.
concept.signature: the TV box of the logo (double bezel + one amber pixel) and RGB LEDs
concept.twist: the site itself 'turns on' like a screen: the loader bezel becomes the hero screen

voice.slogan: ברור כמו לילה. גם בשמש של אוגוסט.

num.use: numbers and specs, echoing the logo's stencil letters

logo.note: client's existing logo, kept as is

icons.signature: a 3x3 amber pixel inside every icon

mascot.name: טיבי
mascot.born_from: the TV box of the logo
mascot.build: 22x14 pixel grid, faces drawn on its own LEDs
rules: born from the hero screen on first visit
at most 6 tips per visit, 11 s apart
mute for a week / hide, remembered
sends its light (a beam) to what it points at

site.entry: bezel draws → one amber LED → scan line → the bezel stretches into the hero screen
proof_tool: screen planner (3 questions → full spec with scale drawing)
sun test (drag the sun, see contrast collapse)
site.agent: screen advisor, answers only from the site's specs and prices, saves leads

campaign.hook: the TV disappears in the sun

honesty.notes: pool/garden/cinema images are the client's own renders; restaurant videos are real
